brief: Design a complete rebuild of DeutschMeister Speaking and the A1.1 commercial funnel before implementation

goals.title: Context audit
goals.objective: Map the current speaking product, course offer, billing, analytics, and recent changes
goals.evidence: Mapped the current product and commercial system: A1.1 is a free 12-lesson course scored 82/100 with 347 focused tests passing but missing recorded audio; Speaking is a 68/100 transcript-led beta with strong architecture but unresolved assessment, access, billing, accessibility, and privacy issues; Pro is EUR 9.99 monthly/EUR 79.99 yearly; paid sub-level courses use lifetime access plus 90 Pro days; Lemon Squeezy webhooks grant subscriptions and purchases; PostHog/funnel tracking and existing launch drafts are present.

goals.title: Product decisions
goals.objective: Define audience, primary promise, success criteria, and commercial constraints with the owner
goals.evidence: Owner decisions: target all adult beginners; lead with a practical A1.1 foundation for everyday German and A1.2 readiness; sell the complete course after a free preview; include a fixed non-expiring speaking allowance; rebuild Speaking as a hybrid of guided tap-to-speak missions and premium real-time conversation; optimize AI for balanced quality/cost; launch organic-first, then introduce a EUR 300-1,000/month test budget when expenses permit.

goals.title: Strategic options
goals.objective: Compare 2-3 coherent product, AI, and monetization approaches
goals.evidence: Compared three coherent offers against current market anchors, current product maturity, and current AI costs. Owner selected Foundation First: three free preview lessons, EUR 39 one-time lifetime A1.1, all guided lesson missions plus a fixed 60-minute speaking balance, followed by an optional approximately EUR 12.99/month AI Coach. Rejected EUR 29 volume positioning because of margin/premium-signal limits and EUR 59 premium positioning because the unknown brand lacks enough proof today.

goals.title: Approved design
goals.objective: Present and validate the product, pedagogy, architecture, UX, pricing, subscription, and sales design
goals.evidence: User approved Foundation First offer, City Conversation Map speaking journey, fixed pricing and allowances, organic sales engine, and specialist-model privacy/release architecture in five explicit review steps.

goals.title: Written specification
goals.objective: Write, self-review, and commit the approved rebuild specification
goals.evidence: Committed a 739-line design specification covering every approved product, UX, pricing, allowance, model-routing, privacy, evaluation, launch, analytics, and definition-of-done decision at commit c32f34b.

goals.title: Implementation handoff
goals.objective: Obtain owner review and transition the approved specification into an executable implementation plan
goals.evidence: Owner approved the design. Wrote and committed a six-file, 1,689-line executable plan set covering course readiness, atomic allowances, guided City Map, realtime mode, quality gates, and organic launch at commit 663748e.
